rules.alternatives: NP specialty certification renewal requires recertification or maintained national certification within the 2 years before the application (ANCC, PNCB, NCC, AANP, ONCC, AACN Certification Corporation).
rules.audit_note: Keep evidence 4 years; the board may require it for audit.

topics.who: Renewal applicants who also apply for a controlled substance license (one-time opioids and controlled substances awareness training, R 338.3135)

rules.notes: Specialty certification renews on the same schedule as the RN license. No NP-specific hours; the RN license still needs 25 hours per 2 years incl. 2 hours pain and symptom management (R 338.10601).
